llm_response.reason: The site uses the Columbus McKinnon company name (a real corporation) at a non-official domain with no evidence of partnership or endorsement. Official Columbus McKinnon sources make no reference to 'eyewebsafety' or this eyewear service. The website itself only displays basic login/signup options, contains no hyperlinks, pricing, products, company details, or legitimate e-commerce functions—behavior not seen on authentic shopping or corporate sites. This fits scam characteristics #4 (non-existent or misused company info), #7 (lack of privacy policy and transparency), and #16 (impersonation/spoofing of a real company), strongly indicating a scam site likely designed to harvest user credentials or personal information.
